summary: Comprehensive testing of Minor Athlete Flow features - 11/11 backend tests passed, frontend features verified via visual inspection and screenshots
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/athletes/minor correctly creates minor athlete with is_minor=True and parent linkage
POST /api/athletes/{id}/detach-parents correctly requires email/password body and validates age >= 18
Admin athletes page 'Minorenne' button opens modal with correct fields: Name, Cognome, DOB, Gender, Team picker, Phone, Parent Email, Data Password
Team picker in minor modal uses Object.values(teams).map() as expected
Admin athlete detail page shows 'Sgancia Genitori' button only for adult athletes (is_minor !== true)
When parents are already detached, page shows 'Genitori sganciati' badge and 'Ricollega Genitori' button instead
Parent dashboard (/parent) correctly shows linked minor athletes with 'Attivo' status
seed_data_creation: Test created minor athlete MARCO VERDI (born 2013-06-15) linked to parent genitore.test@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Minor athlete flow is fully implemented. MARCO VERDI is the test minor (is_minor=true, parents_detached=false). Parent genitore.test@example.com can login and see their minor child. Detach parents only shows for adult athletes (is_minor !== true). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_minor_athlete_flow.py cover all API endpoints.

tests_executed.description: Creates minor athlete with is_minor=True, parent linkage, rejects adults (18+)
Requires email/password body, fails for under 18, creates independent account for 18+
Opens modal with Name, Cognome, DOB, Gender, Team picker, Phone, Parent Email, Data Password fields
Shows 'Sgancia Genitori' for adult athletes, 'Genitori sganciati' + 'Ricollega Genitori' for already detached
Parent sees linked minor children with status, can navigate to 'Registra Nuovo Atleta'
